header.title: Four Editions.
header.subtitle: A verified track record of advancing clean energy and cross-border power in Nepal.

editions.title: Where the clean energy movement began.
editions.story: Nepal's pioneer independent power producers, state utilities, and global equipment makers gathered under one roof at Bhrikutimandap.

editions.title: Building regional clean power momentum.
editions.story: Doubled international footprint with dedicated European and Asian technology pavilions and commercial banking syndicates.

editions.title: Reconvening the sector post-disruption.
editions.story: Focused on silt-abrasion resistant turbines, 400kV gas-insulated substations, and cross-border power transmission.

editions.title: South Asia's clean energy powerhouse.
editions.story: Featured over 100 global brands, official trilateral trade delegations from India and Bangladesh, and landmark power purchase agreements.
